hypothesis: A polynomial-only candidate path can converge from two scan directions to the same unit-closed central kernel and then diverge outward into an exact SAT witness or UNSAT certificate on a nontrivial subset of existing TRUMP workloads, without invoking quarantined exact search in candidate authority.

architecture.name: MEET_THEN_DIVERGE
architecture.formula: F -> CONVERGE_LEFT || CONVERGE_RIGHT -> EXACT_CENTRAL_KERNEL -> POLY_TERMINAL_CORE -> DIVERGE_RECONSTRUCT -> VERIFY

frozen_inputs.root_workloads: existing TRUMP Direct Challenge R0 corpus
frozen_inputs.natural_residuals: R3 pre-truth natural residual probe, max_depth=2, max_residuals=48

gates.G3_NO_FALSE_TERMINALS: 0 candidate terminal disagreements with shadow exact verifier
gates.G4_SAT_RECONSTRUCTION: 0 SAT witness replay failures among candidate SAT terminals
gates.G5_NONTRIVIAL_EXPOSURE: at least 10 candidate terminals across at least 3 existing source families
gates.G7_NO_THEOREM_INFLATION: candidate OPEN on unsupported cores; no arbitrary-CNF completeness claim

success_interpretation: A PASS establishes that meet-then-diverge is an exact polynomial-only terminal architecture on the observed tractable subset. It does not establish a total polynomial arbitrary-CNF solver.
failure_interpretation: Any meet mismatch, false terminal, witness replay failure, hidden quarantined dependency, or insufficient nontrivial exposure blocks promotion.
P_VS_NP_after_R7B_must_remain: OPEN unless a separate total arbitrary-CNF proof is machine-checkably discharged
